card.name: Saltarello
card.profile: Lively Italian dance in fast triple metre named for its leaping step; first recorded in the late-14th/early-15th-c. Tuscan manuscript British Library Add MS 29987. Survives as a couples’ folk dance played on zampogna or organetto with tamburello. Distinct from the pizzica/tarantella family. NOT UNESCO.
